entries: Come, feed upon the essence the dark lord left beneath this place.
来吧，享用黑暗领主在此地之下留下的精粹。
Something tells me our diets are not at all similar.
直觉告诉我，我们的食谱完全不是一回事。
Unnatural? I feed and grow just as you do.
不自然？我和你们一样，进食、生长。
What you call food is questionable.
你所谓的食物，可大有疑问。
What manner of unnatural beast is this?
这是何等不自然的野兽？
He has not revealed himself for many cycles, but his children still grow. He left much food for us.
他已经许多轮不曾现身，可他的子嗣仍在滋长。他给我们留下了许多食物。
It is more than just food. It is a feast! And now.. I will feast upon you!
这何止是食物。这是一场盛宴！而现在……我要以你们为宴！
